_comment: EXAMPLE — SRR(스르륵) 앱 기준으로 채운 샘플. 실제 사용 시 이 파일을 $PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/mobile-qa.config.json 으로 복사하고 값을 프로젝트에 맞게 고친다. 이 파일은 커밋되는 비민감 설정이며 자격증명을 담지 않는다.

auth._loggedInMarkers_comment: notification-btn is a testID on the post-login StarScreen header — language-independent, so it is the reliable signal. Tab labels are belt-and-braces for both locales; note the Korean label is '나의 수면' (shared/i18n/locales/ko.json -> tabs.mySleep), not '내수면'.
auth._loginEntryMarkers_comment: REQUIRED whenever loggedOutMarkers describes a landing screen that has no credential fields. On SRR's InitialScreen the user must tap 'log-in-link' before email-input exists. The Android login script deliberately refuses to tap any button that is not listed here, so that it never starts the Kakao OAuth flow by accident.
auth._errorMarkers_comment: Inline errors from EmailLoginScreen when Firebase rejects the credentials (shared/i18n/locales/ko.json -> emailLoginScreen.*). Presence of any means 'credentials rejected' (exit 7) rather than 'still waiting' (exit 8). UNVERIFIED against a real uiautomator dump — confirm exact strings on the first real run.
